#define IS_NEWLINE(p) \
  ((NLBLOCK->nltype != NLTYPE_FIXED)? \
    ((p) < NLBLOCK->PSEND && \
     PRIV(is_newline)((p), NLBLOCK->nltype, NLBLOCK->PSEND, \
       &(NLBLOCK->nllen), utf)) \
    : \
    ((p) <= NLBLOCK->PSEND - NLBLOCK->nllen && \
     UCHAR21TEST(p) == NLBLOCK->nl[0] && \
     (NLBLOCK->nllen == 1 || UCHAR21TEST(p+1) == NLBLOCK->nl[1])       \
    ) \
  )
